space.period_totals_v3: Period: from {{from}} to {{to}} (excluded). Referrals sent: {{sent}}; referrals declined for lack of capacity: {{unmet}}; out-of-scope referrals: {{outOfScope}} ({{note}}).
space.method.declined_capacity: Referrals declined for lack of capacity: referrals to which the receiving organisation answered “no capacity”. This is not a number of unmet needs: the person may have been referred elsewhere afterwards and supported, and a need that never led to a referral is not counted.
space.method.completeness: Coverage and bias: only organisations that are registered, verified and located by their address are counted — a municipality or a need that is absent does not mean there is no need; the reason for a referral is chosen by the referring organisation from nine reasons; the “no capacity” answer is declared by the receiving organisation; an answer given after the quarter is frozen is not included; appointments booked without an account do not count among citizen accounts. These figures describe the activity recorded in the platform, not the situation of the area.
space.method.non_recours: These figures measure neither non-take-up of rights, nor services actually provided, nor people helped: they are recorded referrals and appointments. Measuring non-take-up would require knowing who could claim a right and does not receive it — the platform does not decide eligibility and receives no data from the paying bodies. The needs people express, the aids they look at and the steps they follow stay in their personal space and are not counted.
space.quarter_withheld: The last closed quarter is not frozen yet: none of its values is published before it is frozen.
space.periode_dernier_trimestre_civil: Period: the last complete calendar quarter (the only period published, so that no hidden value can be deduced from two overlapping periods).
space.pw_failed: Change not possible at the moment. Try again.
space.pw_mismatch: The two entries of the new password are different.
space.reserve_aux_partenaires_ayant: Reserved for partners who have signed an agreement with Accès Direct Aide. This space only shows aggregated statistics.
space.sans_acces_cette_adresse: . Without access to this address, write to the ADA team from the page
space.session_ended: Your session has ended (sign-out, password change, end of agreement or 8 hours elapsed). Sign in again.
space.vos_autres_sessions_seront: Your other sessions will be closed.
space.vous_etes_connecte_avec: You are signed in with a temporary password given by ADA. Choose your own password to access the statistics.
space.totals_note: sum of the published cells only
space.method.sources: Appointments and referrals recorded in the platform by verified organisations (no estimate, no external data).
space.method.out_of_scope: Referrals to which the receiving organisation answered “outside our scope”: a referral sent to the wrong place, counted separately — it is not an unmet need.
space.method.limits_v2: Only requests made through the platform are counted; a municipality appears only with at least 3 verified organisations, and every municipality shown is listed in the table even without a referral; any value below 5 is hidden, and another value in the same column is hidden too when it would be the only hidden one.
space.method.totals: No true total is published: the totals and the trend by quarter add up only the published values of the table by need. When one of the two tables (by need, by municipality) has hidden values and the other has none, the two smallest values of the other are hidden too: otherwise the difference between the two tables would give the sum of the hidden values.
space.method.periods: Complete calendar quarters only, without overlap (no month, year or free period: two nested periods would make it possible to recover a hidden value).
space.scope_undefined: The authorised territory of your account is not defined: no statistic can be shown. Contact ADA.
space.by_need_withheld: Your territory is smaller than its intermunicipal body (intercommunalité): the table by need is not published at this scale, because the difference between two nested territories would give back masked values.
space.by_need_partial: The table by need counts only the intermunicipal bodies (intercommunalités) that lie entirely inside your territory.
space.totals_note_commune: sum of the published cells of the table by municipality only
space.method.territory: Only the municipalities of your account’s authorised territory are counted, from the declared address of the organisations (municipality name and postal code must agree). The table by need adds up the published values of the intermunicipal bodies (intercommunalités) that lie entirely inside this territory; a territory smaller than its intermunicipal body has no table by need, because the difference between two nested territories would give back masked values.
